maria_prod: Quick async check — quarterly OKR milestone sync. Drop a one-liner: what shipped, what slipped, owners and any blockers/deps for the next 2 weeks. I’ll compile.
aj_eng: Shipped: model-routing v1 canary to Dedicated. Perf looks stable, p95 ~120ms. Owner: aj_eng. Next: scale test on burst pool (need SRE). :rocket:
lina_pm: Slipped: eval harness for quantized variants — moved to EOW from EOD. Owner: lina_pm. Blocker: missing test vectors from infra (cc @sam_sre).
sam_sre: I’ve got infra tickets open (INF-342) for GPU burst pool access. ETA Wed. For test vectors — can you confirm a storage path/name I should expect?
kai_eng: CR ping @dave_eng on PR #4214 (routing + KV-cache fix). Small change, needs perf sanity check before merge.
dave_eng: On it, aiming to review today. Noted a flaky integration test — will comment in PR.
aj_eng: Dependency: canary rollout depends on control-plane pin for runtime version. @lina_pm — do you want to defer canary if quantized eval slips or proceed with routing-only?
lina_pm: Proceed with routing canary, hold quantized rollout. I’ll update the OKR sheet to reflect the slip and the plan.
sam_sre: If canary proceeds I’ll schedule burst nodes for Thu 09:00 PT. Config note for deploy: `burst_pool=true` (add to deploy-override).
ci-bot: Test results: build/4214 — unit: pass, integration: flaky (2/3). Details: https://ci.redwood/builds/4214
kai_eng: Re-running integration with smaller batch-size to reproduce. Pinging @qa_lead for a quick smoke when done.
aj_eng: Also shipped: docs update for routing & rollback playbook (added to Console notes). :memo:
maria_prod: Thanks — I’ll collate into the quarterly status doc. Action items: @dave_eng review PR, @sam_sre schedule burst nodes, @lina_pm mark quantized eval as slipped. Add any other one-liners here by EOD and I’ll publish the summary.
dave_eng: Review complete, left 1 comment. Will merge after CI stabilizes.
sam_sre: Burst nodes scheduled Thu 09:00 PT. I’ll post runbook and any post-deploy notes if something pops.
lina_pm: OKR updated, slipped row annotated with owner and mitigations. Thanks.
maria_prod: :thumbsup: Closing once I publish the compiled snapshot.
